behaviorNotes: Radix Dialog 1.3.1 renders role=dialog but never sets aria-modal; Modal sets aria-modal=true explicitly after reproducing the gap in the read-only review.
Each page passes its own root as the Portal container so catalog data-theme variables and Twin CSS scoping survive the portal.
URL/store-driven dialogs have no Dialog.Trigger, so Modal records the render-time activeElement and restores it only while it is still connected; Radix's own restore is suppressed.

Only the topmost DismissableLayer handles Escape; onEscapeKeyDown stops propagation so Twin window shortcuts (Escape clears selection/YMS) do not run, and twin-page also ignores already-defaultPrevented events.
The non-modal onboarding bubble stays outside the abstraction; the OEM/architecture, YMS and catalog detail dialogs share the same Modal.

reviewNotes.independentReview: Read-only review reproduced the missing aria-modal and drove the explicit fix; the final diff was re-checked and both headless-browser probes were run on the committed tree.
